headline: British Guns End Zanzibar Resistance in Under an Hour
dispatch: British warships opened fire on the sultan's palace at Zanzibar this morning, and within 38 minutes the Sultanate had surrendered, making the engagement the shortest war on record. The palace was set ablaze and the Sultanate's small naval vessel sunk in the harbour. Sultan Khalid bin Barghash took refuge in the German consulate as British-backed Hamud bin Mohammed was installed in his place.
answer: Zanzibar surrenders to Britain after 38-minute war, 1896
